title: Exits that end with nowhere to go (V3 private not landed, unknown dex/feeTier, routine pause) return false without marking the position failed-held or re-arming its poll timer, after anti-rug and dashboard callers already cleared that timer

evidence.note: V3 private escalation not landed: error log + alert "Position stays held + monitored", then return false; no markExitFailedHeld, no keepMonitoringFailedHeld, no timer re-arm
a dex that is neither V3-with-feeTier nor V2 (for example a V3 dex with feeTier null) logs "Unknown DEX type" and returns false the same way
routine-paused positions return false for any routine reason before any work
anti-rug clears all timers for the token BEFORE calling executeFullSell
dashboard force-sell clears timers first (:167 emergency-sell does the same)
contrast: keepMonitoringFailedHeld is the path that persists exit_failed_held and re-arms the timer when it was cleared; these early returns skip it
codex (22-27 independent second opinion, graded S1): Early full-sell returns bypass failed-held recovery

sibling_sites_checked: Every return false in executeFullSell: :829 (routine pause), :834 (sell lock held by another exit; the in-flight exit owns the outcome), :878 (unknown dex), :996 (inconclusive, goes through keepMonitoringFailedHeld, correct), :1036 (V3 no fallback), :1111 and :1167 (both through keepMonitoringFailedHeld, correct), :1156 (closed, correct). Callers that clear timers first: exitTrigger.ts:240, controls.ts:92, controls.ts:167. The worker path (routine triggers) never clears the timer, so for it the timer survives. The dashboard emergency-sell / force-sell selection gap for failed-held positions is the sibling owned by 22-22 under ESC-PRE-04 (key:API:failed-held-sell-selection); it is referenced here and not escalated again.
severity_rationale: S1. Proven by the code. Plausible condition: an anti-rug or dashboard exit of a V3 position whose private sell does not land (no relay inclusion, or a transfer-taxed V3 token, AUD-EXIT-006). The position is then held with anti-rug still registered but no routine poll at all, while the alert says it stays monitored. Bounded below S0 because a restart resumes it (the trade row is still pending) and anti-rug stays registered.
recommendation: Route every non-closing return through the same balance-truth handling as the catch (persist exit_failed_held, re-arm the timer, alert truthfully), or make the callers re-arm when the sell returns false. Card EXIT-06 decides what a V3 position with no fallback should do. Phase 24.

steps: executeFullSell throws anywhere after the sell lock (approve revert, wait() CALL_EXCEPTION or TRANSACTION_REPLACED, RPC error, reconcile error) -> catch (:1112)
balanceOf is re-fetched (:1128-1130); if that fails the balance is treated as held (sentinel -1n, :1131-1140)
balance <= dust -> teardownGenuineClose, the trade is marked sold, alert "sell reported failure but position closed" (:1143-1157)
balance > dust (or unknown): updateTradeStatus("failed", token, chain) (:1163) moves every pending row of that token on that chain to trades.status=failed (db.ts:325-327)
keepMonitoringFailedHeld (:687): markExitFailedHeld (:700) sets exit_state.exit_status=exit_failed_held and exit_failure_count+1 (db.ts:540-545); exit_state is kept; anti-rug stays registered
If the poll timer was cleared (anti-rug or dashboard path) it is re-armed through resumeExitMonitor with ctx.chain.snipeAmount (:723-732; probe mismatch for deliberate buys, AUD-EXIT-015)
Routine reason and failure count >= EXIT_ROUTINE_MAX_FAILURES (5): routine retries are paused in memory with a hard alert (:738-749); anti-rug bypasses the pause
After a restart getResumeExitMonitorTrades unions exit_failed_held rows (db.ts:597-604), so the position is resumed; the in-memory pause is gone and returns after the next failure

Sibling, owned by 22-22 under ESC-PRE-04 (key:API:failed-held-sell-selection): the dashboard emergency-sell and force-sell select only status pending, so this failed-held position is not offered for a manual sell
A later genuine close calls updateTradeStatus("sold"), which matches pending rows only, so the buy row stays failed while deleteExitState removes the row
traces.outcome: State written: trades.status=failed on the buy row(s) of that token; exit_state.exit_status=exit_failed_held with an incremented failure count; anti-rug kept; timer re-armed. The early returns this finding names (:829, :878, :1036) write none of this.
